rank_math_desc: Amboseli and Mara fly-in safari for 5 days: elephants below Kilimanjaro, then big cats in the Masai Mara, with light-aircraft flights. Price on request.
post_content: This Amboseli and Mara fly-in safari combines Kenya's two most famous parks in five days, with flights instead of long drives.
overview:
This Amboseli and Mara fly-in safari is Kenya's classic pairing made easy. You start with elephants and Kilimanjaro in Amboseli, then fly to the Masai Mara for lions, cheetahs and, in season, the great migration.

Flying saves about ten hours of driving, giving you more time on game drives and less time on the road.

Why choose this Amboseli and Mara fly-in safari?

  • Two parks, two landscapes: mountain views in Amboseli, open plains in the Mara.
  • Big Five chances: elephants, lions, buffaloes, leopards and sometimes rhinos.
  • Less driving: short flights between Nairobi and each park.
  • Comfortable lodges: Ol Tukai Lodge and Mara Serena Safari Lodge.

Where you stay

Two nights at Ol Tukai Lodge in Amboseli and two nights at Mara Serena Safari Lodge, or similar.

Best time for an Amboseli and Mara fly-in safari

July to October is ideal for the migration in the Mara and dry, clear days in Amboseli. January to March is also excellent, with fewer visitors.

faq.q: How do I get from Amboseli to the Masai Mara?
faq.a: By light aircraft, usually connecting through Wilson Airport in Nairobi. The whole journey takes a few hours with a short wait between flights.

faq.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faq.a: Light aircraft usually allow 15 kg per person, including hand luggage, in soft bags without wheels. Ask us if you need extra space.

faq.q: Which lodges are used on the Amboseli and Mara fly-in safari?
faq.a: Ol Tukai Lodge in Amboseli and Mara Serena Safari Lodge in the Masai Mara, or similar.

faq.q: Is this a good honeymoon safari?
faq.a: Yes. Short flights, great lodges and two iconic parks make it a popular honeymoon choice.

faq.q: Can I add a beach stay?
faq.a: Yes. You can fly from the Mara to Diani or Zanzibar after the safari.
If you travel between July and October, there is a good chance of seeing the herds and river crossings.

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Fly from Nairobi to Amboseli
itinerary.content: Morning flight from Wilson Airport to Amboseli and a game drive to Ol Tukai Lodge. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Full day in Amboseli
itinerary.content: Sunrise game drive for Kilimanjaro views and elephant herds, with a second drive in the afternoon.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Fly from Amboseli to the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: Morning game drive, then fly to the Masai Mara via Wilson Airport. Afternoon game drive and check-in at Mara Serena Safari Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Full day in the Masai Mara
itinerary.content: A full day of game drives with a picnic lunch, looking for lions, cheetahs and leopards. Optional balloon flight.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Fly back to Nairobi
itinerary.content: Early game drive, breakfast and a flight back to Wilson Airport.
